risk_note: H5 find-order page /find-order (apps/h5; submits an attribution claim through the signed bridge path, RV1). Contracts createOrderClaim, listOrderClaims, issueH5Token and app.getConfig (implemented); visuals per design/specs/app-find-order.md. Open platforms from config features, window days from claim.window_days, guide link only when configured; one signed submit with errors placed per code and linked to inputs; 30203 / 30206 disabled for the Shanghai day without counts; success and 30205 switch to records and locate the claim across up to 5 pages with contract normalization of order numbers; records per sub-order without the claimant or raw reason codes; 10405 never replayed and every automatic refetch disabled. Account-switch isolation is provided by the shell (F1-01s #1127); the page no longer clears the shared cache. Route split keeps the first chunk at 149740 bytes gzip under the 150 KiB budget. Rule tests by Codex in three calls; Claude spec-test review r3 pass; red on the test machine (red/3: 52 red, 0 problems). Implementation by Opus 5.5 in five rounds including the rebase adaptation after F1-01s (orchestrator ruling D10-123); test machine verify-fast and browser green. Review: Codex (approvals id 27 / 34 / 36). Written by hand.
